create_mimic_cxr_dataset: create a MimicCxrJpgDataset instance to load MIMIC CXR chest X-ray images with labels for training
load_mimic_cxr_split: load a specific train, val, or test split of the MIMIC CXR dataset using MimicCxrJpgDataset
get_default_labels: get the default list of 14 CheXpert radiology labels from MimicCxrJpgDataset.default_labels static method
preprocess_mimic_cxr_csv: preprocess the MIMIC CXR metadata CSV to normalize view positions and apply subselect queries
retrieve_cxr_sample: retrieve a chest X-ray image sample with labels and metadata by index from MimicCxrJpgDataset
